sources.citation: Diyānat (Dianat), Leylā. 1395 [2016]. Farāyand-e hamguni dar zabān-e Lāri [The assimilation process in the Lari language]. Do-faslnāme-ye zabānšenāsi-ye guyešhā-ye Irāni (Journal of Iranian Dialect Linguistics, Shiraz University) 1(1): 53-72
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Does not state where stress falls. Literature review p. 56 reports second-hand that Kamioka & Yamada (1358 [1979]) recorded 1000 Lari words, extracted the phoneme system and 'also briefly discussed stress in this language' (mokhtasari darbāre-ye takye). Bibliography names the Persian MA theses on Lari phonology: Ahmadniā 1385 (Razi Univ., generative phonology of Achomi), Kāmyāb 1370 and Sami'i 1371 (Shiraz).

sources.note: Nothing: a sociolinguistic survey of Larestani materials on Persian websites; the only hits for 'акцент' are lexical glosses (lahje 'accent'); no phonology, no stress statement. Bibliography (pp. 103-106) lists Persian-language studies of Lari (Moridi 2009; Sadighi & Rostampour 2013; Xonji 1388; Salāmi vols 4-6, etc.).
